W.note: Plain, complete two-player game with row/column aria-labels, live status, clear win highlight, dark mode and a solid phone layout; no layout glitches.

X.note: Correct with scores and alternating starter, but the board rows squash unevenly once marks appear, labels are only 'Cell n', and there is no cell-state announcement.

Y.note: Best-looking with SVG marks, arrow keys and focus handling, but it adds a computer opponent, scoreboard and mode toggle (overbuilt) and the board rows visibly squash at game end.

Z.note: Smallest and cleanest working game with a fixed grid that stays stable, but only 'Cell n' labels, no focus styling, and a bare look.
